proj.note: terms u^i v^j for i in 0..3, j in 0..3, i+j<=3; fwd u,v = dlon,dlat deg -> east,north m; inv u,v = east/1e4,north/1e4 -> dlon,dlat

sources: Towns: Overture Maps divisions; roads and railways: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) via Overture Maps; photo: Sentinel-2 L2A, 32 m per pixel

dem.source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (ESA, 30 m surface model), resampled to 32 m
